description: An approval of a document, with the clauses that need attention highlighted. Only invited people can open it.

input.title: Approve the Acme data processing addendum
input.question: Can we sign the Acme data processing addendum as written?

data.text:
# Data processing addendum

Acme may use subprocessors in the EU and US.

Customer data is deleted **within 90 days** of termination.

Acme notifies the customer of a breach within 72 hours.

data.statement: Approve signing the Acme data processing addendum as written.
